content.storyline: Cincinnati enters atop the AFC North at 7-2, while Washington is third in the NFC East at 3-5-1 after a 24-21 win over the Giants. Washington’s win kept its NFC East title hopes alive, giving this matchup division-race stakes for both teams.
matchup_notes: Cincinnati beat Pittsburgh 38-18 in Week 10, moving into sole possession of first place in the AFC North.
The Bengals have won five straight after starting 2-2 and scored at least 30 points in all five wins.
Washington beat the Giants 24-21 in Week 10; the win improved its record to 3-5-1 and kept it in contention in the NFC East.
Washington’s defense has forced six turnovers in its past three games combined.
